Our story

Richard Jucker's craft, since 1981

I'm Richard Jucker — the creator and owner of The Village Bakery. As a native Houstonian, I have spent almost my entire adult life in the bakery business. My father was one of the original owners of Three Brothers Bakery, and I worked there from 1981 to 1999; in May 2013, I opened my own bakery.

I spent years perfecting my craft — sculpted cakes, hand-painted portrait cakes and wedding cakes. If it's a custom creation you need, I'll work closely with you to come up with a design that combines quality and creativity.

A family-owned business, committed to its community.

What we make

Cakes for every occasion, and the everyday case

Every item is made from scratch with high-quality, all-natural ingredients. After just one bite, you'll understand why our customers keep coming back.

Wedding Cakes

Bridal and wedding cakes: elegant tiers, sugar flowers and the design you dreamed of, planned with you.

Baby Shower Cakes

Sweet welcomes: gift-box cakes, bassinets and the tiniest baby details.

Sculptures & Shaped Cakes

The house specialty: characters, ships, sports and whatever you imagine, sculpted in cake.

Birthday Cakes & Drawings

Edible drawings and portraits on cake: your idea, hand-painted at the center of the party.

Holiday Cakes

Valentine's, Easter, Christmas and every date on the calendar with its own cake.

Cupcakes

By the dozen and to your theme: sugar skulls, flowers, teams and celebrations of every kind.

Cookies

Hand-decorated one by one, plus the case classics: butter cookies, linzer and more.

Pies

Traditional and holiday favorites: deep dish apple, Texas pecan, lemon meringue and pumpkin.

Pastries

Chocolate éclairs, Mardi Gras king cake and seasonal sweets, made fresh.

Breads

Braided challah, baguettes and rustic loaves, baked fresh.
